data_shape: generated on the worker host (NOT the hosted volume): 22500 symbols/day of which 20200 warrant-like, 500 trading days, collector batches of 500 records, 6511490 B normalized per day
commands: bench script (scratch, not committed): shaped one-day dual write, current-reader scan, 500-day store build and reads

acceptance_1_reproduction_one_trade_date.note: raw bytes are small because the generated records are tiny and gzip; real records are 1.2-1.5 KB per the design, so the byte figures understate hosted; file counts (45 run files per store per day) are the structural finding

acceptance_5_reader.note: design 5.2 asks 2 years x 1 symbol <= 500 ms; measured 0.65 s on this host, over that figure. It is not this task's acceptance (reader p95 for 60x50 is) and is reported for the later reader-consumer task

acceptance_8_budget_rows.synthetic_caveat: generated prices compress better than real ones; design estimate is 60 B/row, measured here 47 B/row; re-measure on the hosted volume at deploy

stores_not_touched: raw/normalized/features run files (still written exactly as before)
scope_notes: Dual write lives in MarketDataStorageWriter.write_run for dataset tw_price_daily; a daily_bars failure is counted (dual_write_errors, last_error in health) and never raised into the ingest run, so current behaviour is unchanged.

Batches are merged into the day by key (upsert); an unchanged merged digest writes nothing; a changed one writes a new generation and swaps the manifest last. A kill at after_temp_write, after_fsync, after_lineage or before_manifest_rename leaves the previous complete set (parametrized test).
Listing allowlist (T8) does not exist yet: write_records takes an optional listing and counts skipped_not_listed; no symbol pattern rule is added. Without a listing nothing is filtered by symbol.
A record needs a trade date from trade_date/as_of_date/date/event_time; available_time and created_at are never used. Missing or contradictory market fails closed (rejected_other).
Not done here: nothing reads daily_bars except tests; runtime.py was not edited (store is created inside MarketDataStorageWriter), so the store root is the existing market data storage root.
